_meta.description: ONE canonical AnalyticalDimension register (discriminated by dimensionType: cost-center / cost-object / custom) replacing the prior CostCenter + KostenDrager + AnalyticalDimension triple.008: dimensionType discriminator, cost-center-specific props (budget/spentToDate/allocatedBudget/organizationId/responsibleUser/ondernemingsActiviteit), shared hierarchy (parentCode) + lifecycle for all types, re-homed aggregations (segmentPnl/spentToDate/allocatedBudget scoped to cost-center; byCostCenter/byCostCenterHierarchy/byCostObject/byAnalyticalDimension on GLLine), idempotent migration via UnifyAnalyticalDimensions. Seeds carry dimensionType so greenfield installs land the unified shape. GLLine FK relations re-targeted. Nav filtered views + label unification.

AnalyticalDimension.title: Analytical Dimension
AnalyticalDimension.description: ONE canonical operator-extensible analytical dimension register, discriminated by dimensionType (cost-center / cost-object / custom). Replaces the prior CostCenter (kostenplaats), KostenDrager (kostendrager), and custom AnalyticalDimension registers. Cost-center rows carry budget + spentToDate + allocatedBudget + ondernemingsActiviteit; cost-object rows carry hierarchy without budget; custom rows carry dataType / isHierarchical / referenceSchema metadata. All types share code / name / parentCode / lifecycleState / administrationId. CRUD is exclusively via OpenRegister's generic object surface (ADR-022).

code.description: Stable operator-facing dimension code, unique per (administrationId, dimensionType). Referenced as a key in GLLine.dimensions (custom), GLLine.costCenterCode (cost-center), GLLine.kostenDragerCode (cost-object), VpbBalansLink.costCenterId (cost-center with ondernemingsActiviteit). Preserved byte-for-byte by the UnifyAnalyticalDimensions migration.
code.title: Code

name.description: Human-readable dimension name shown in the operator UI and segment P&L drill-down.
name.title: Name

description.description: Optional long-form description of the dimension and its intended use.
description.title: Description

dimensionType.description: Discriminator. cost-center = kostenplaats (carries budget / ondernemingsActiviteit surface); cost-object = kostendrager (hierarchy without budget); custom = operator-defined dimension (carries dataType / isHierarchical / referenceSchema metadata); project = former CostProject folded into AnalyticalDimension (carries totalBudget / totalEstimatedCosts / projectNumber / startDate / endDate / externalProjectRef / budgetVariance; budget-vs-actuals via GL-derived spentToDate). Required on every row.
dimensionType.title: Dimension Type

parentCode.description: FK to parent AnalyticalDimension.code (within the same dimensionType and administrationId) for hierarchy navigation. Drives the byCostCenterHierarchy / byCostObject roll-up aggregations.
parentCode.title: Parent Code

lifecycleState.description: Operator-managed activation state. Archived dimensions remain referenced from historical GL lines but cannot be selected on new postings.
lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle State

administrationId.description: Owning administratie. Dimensions are scoped per administration; the same code MAY exist with different dimensionTypes across administrations.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

status.description: Convenience alias of lifecycleState for active/inactive integrations. Applies to cost-center rows only; cost-object and custom rows should use lifecycleState directly.
status.title: Status

budget.description: Allocated annual or periodic budget amount in EUR. Applies only when dimensionType = cost-center. Constrained to two-decimal cents via multipleOf to prevent IEEE-754 drift.
budget.title: Budget

spentToDate.description: Derived via x-openregister-aggregations: sum of GLLine.amount where costCenterCode = @self.code AND side = debit. Applies only when dimensionType = cost-center. Read-only.
spentToDate.title: Spent To Date

allocatedBudget.description: Derived via x-openregister-calculations: budget + sum(children.allocatedBudget) recursively. Applies only when dimensionType = cost-center. Read-only.
allocatedBudget.title: Allocated Budget

organizationId.description: FK to the Organization owning this dimension. Typically meaningful for cost-center and cost-object rows.
organizationId.title: Organization ID

responsibleUser.description: Nextcloud user id of the dimension owner. Applies to cost-center and cost-object rows.
responsibleUser.title: Responsible User

enterpriseActivity.description: Marks this cost-center dimension as an ondernemingsactiviteit per Wet modernisering Vpb-plicht (2016). When true, the dimension MAY be referenced by a VpbBalansLink. Only meaningful when dimensionType = cost-center. Default false.
enterpriseActivity.title: Ondernemings Activiteit

dataType.description: JSON value type for the dimension. Required only when dimensionType = custom. reference indicates the value MUST be a slug of another register (operator picks the target via referenceRegister/referenceSchema). Not applicable to cost-center or cost-object rows.
dataType.title: Data Type

isHierarchical.description: When true, the dimension supports parent-child roll-up via the parentCode self-relation. Drives drill-down navigation. Most meaningful for custom dimensions; cost-center and cost-object hierarchy is always via parentCode.
isHierarchical.title: Is Hierarchical

referenceRegister.description: When dataType=reference, the slug of the register the dimension value references (typically shillinq). Applies to custom dimensions only.
referenceRegister.title: Reference Register

referenceSchema.description: When dataType=reference, the slug of the schema the dimension value references (e.g. Contact, Project). Applies to custom dimensions only.
referenceSchema.title: Reference Schema

sortOrder.description: Display order in the operator UI. Most meaningful for custom dimensions.
sortOrder.title: Sort Order

totalBudget.description: Authorised spend ceiling for project-flavoured cost centers in integer cents (e.g. 5000000 = €50.000,00). Applies when dimensionType = project. Reused with spentToDate (GL-derived) and budgetVariance (calculated) for budget-vs-actuals. Optional and nullable for plain departmental cost centers.
totalBudget.title: Total Budget

totalEstimatedCosts.description: Project-manager estimate of total project costs in integer cents. Applies when dimensionType = project. Optional and nullable for plain cost centers.
totalEstimatedCosts.title: Total Estimated Costs

projectNumber.description: Operator-facing project label (was CostProject.projectNumber). Non-unique: code remains the unique key. Applies when dimensionType = project; ignored for plain cost centers.
projectNumber.title: Project Number

startDate.description: Time-box start date (was CostProject.startDate). Applies when dimensionType = project; optional for plain cost centers.
startDate.title: Start Date

endDate.description: Time-box end date (was CostProject.endDate). Applies when dimensionType = project; optional for plain cost centers.
endDate.title: End Date

externalProjectRef.description: ADR-019 integration-registry reference to an external OpenProject delivery project. Stores an OpenProject project id/URL and cached display label only. Resolution routes through OpenRegister ExternalIntegrationRouter and the OpenProject IntegrationProvider (external storage strategy, OpenConnector-backed). shillinq stores NO OpenProject delivery data. Cardinality 0.1. Valid and inert when the OpenProject provider is not yet registered (ADR-019 permissive-on-read).
externalProjectRef.title: External Project Ref

migratedFrom.description: Migration provenance marker written by RetireCostProjectStep. Contains the source CostProject id from which this AnalyticalDimension was created. Used for idempotency: dimensions with this marker are skipped on repair re-runs. Not editable.
migratedFrom.title: Migrated From

active.label: Active
active.description: Usable for GL line dimension tagging.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Readable but rejected as target of new GL line dimension tags.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Historical only; no new dimension tags.

block.label: Block dimension
block.description: Prevent new GL line tagging against this dimension.

unblock.label: Unblock dimension
unblock.description: Re-enable GL line tagging against this dimension.

archive.label: Archive dimension
archive.description: Move to historical archive; GL lines with this code remain queryable.

segmentPnl.description: Segment P&L per cost-center: debit/credit sums of non-eliminated GLLine amounts, grouped by costCenterCode + periodId + accountNumber. Returns EVERY cost-center; narrow to one with the extraFilter query params (?costCenterCode=.). It does not correlate on @self: no caller supplies a parent row. Parent roll-up over the parentCode tree is NOT included here; byCostCenterHierarchy does that through the join.

segmentPnlByCostObject.description: Segment P&L per cost-object: debit/credit sums of non-eliminated GLLine amounts, grouped by costCarrierCode + periodId + accountNumber. Returns EVERY cost-object; narrow to one with the extraFilter query params (?costCarrierCode=.). Replaces the retired KostenDrager.segmentPnl; the field is costCarrierCode: kostenDragerCode is not declared on GLLine and matched nothing.

spentToDate.description: Sum of GL debit postings tagged to this cost-center dimension (recursive over descendant cost-centers via parentCode self-relation). Excludes eliminated intercompany lines. Scoped dimensionType = cost-center.

allocatedBudget.description: Roll-up budget for cost-center dimensions: this dimension's own budget plus the allocatedBudget of every child cost-center reached via the parentCode self-relation (recursive descent). Applies only when dimensionType = cost-center.

budgetVariance.description: Budget-vs-actuals variance for project-flavoured cost centers: authorised spend ceiling minus GL-derived costs incurred to date. Mirrors the retired CostProject.budgetVariance. Positive = under budget, negative = over budget. Applies only when dimensionType = project and totalBudget is set; zero otherwise.

byCostCenter.description: Per-cost-center roll-up of posted GL amounts within an administration. Surfaces segment P&L per AnalyticalDimension[dimensionType=cost-center].code (joined to name for drill-down). Declared declaratively per ADR-031: no PHP SegmentReportService. Re-targeted from CostCenter to AnalyticalDimension.

byCostCenterHierarchy.description: Hierarchical roll-up of GL amounts per AnalyticalDimension[dimensionType=cost-center].parentCode tree. Child cost-center sums propagate to parents through the self-relation; drives drill-down navigation. Declarative (ADR-031). Re-targeted from CostCenter to AnalyticalDimension.

byCostObject.description: Per-cost-object (kostendrager) roll-up of posted GL amounts. Replaces the retired KostenDrager.segmentPnl. Joins GLLine.kostenDragerCode to AnalyticalDimension[dimensionType=cost-object].code. Declarative (ADR-031).

byProject.description: Per-project roll-up of posted GL amounts within an administration. Surfaces project P&L for consultancy and grant-funded work. Declarative (ADR-031).

byAnalyticalDimension.description: Per-custom-dimension roll-up of posted GL amounts. Each registered AnalyticalDimension[dimensionType=custom] contributes a group-by key drawn from GLLine.dimensions[code]. Drives the operator-extensible segment P&L surface; new custom dimensions appear automatically without PHP/Vue edits. Scoped dimensionType = custom.

objects.name: Region
objects.description: Geographic region (e.g. Noord-Holland, Zuid-Holland). Surfaces regional P&L per municipality / branch.

objects.name: Product Line
objects.description: Product line (e.g. Hosting, Consulting, Training). Surfaces product-mix P&L for revenue-side analytics.

objects.name: Sales Utrecht
objects.description: Sales team based in Utrecht (Randstad-Oost coverage).
